connector.registryDescription: Validate EU, UK, AU VAT numbers for AI agents. EU ViDA e-invoicing compliance.
connector.summary: Hosted at vat-validator-mcp-production.up.railway.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package vat-validator-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ojaskord account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
